# Model state and lookups

Read an auxiliary, delay, level, flow, series, table, variable, conversion or the path network.

Each value is the expression read as an auxiliary at t = 20 of a small model (time step 0.5) with a resource `Desk` of capacity 2 and a stream of arrivals that outruns it, a level `Tank` filled by the flow `fill`, a conversion `Digester` into the level `Holder`, a delay, a series, a table, a variable, a power draw, a two-node network and a subscript `region` with three elements.

## AUX

`AUX("name")`: 1 argument.

auxiliary NAME, evaluated on read.

Example: `AUX("base") * 2` gives 8.

Used in the bundled models Supply line: order-rate management game, Bass diffusion, Inventory with lead time, Population (logistic) and 3 more.

## CONV

`CONV("name")`: 1 argument.

the product rate of delayed conversion NAME right now, per its time_unit.

Example: `CONV("Digester")` gives 47.62.

Used in the bundled models Biogas digester, holder and CHP, Biogas plant (library assets).

## DELAY

`DELAY("name")`: 1 argument.

output of delay NAME.

Example: `DELAY("pipe")` gives 9.765.

## DISTANCE

`DISTANCE("a", "b")`: 2 arguments.

shortest path along the path network between two nodes, stations or aliases.

Example: `DISTANCE("dock", "yard")` gives 100.

## FLOW

`FLOW("name")`: 1 argument.

the rate flow NAME moves right now, after saturation, per its rate_time_unit.

Example: `FLOW("fill")` gives 2.

Used in the bundled models Berth: shore power, Biogas digester, holder and CHP, Biogas plant (library assets), Depot: PV, EV charging and heat pump and 5 more.

## FLOWSUM

`FLOWSUM("tag"[, p])`: 1 to 2 arguments.

the rates of every flow tagged TAG (priority below p), per their rate_time_unit.

Example: `FLOWSUM("water")` gives 2.

Used in the bundled models Berth: shore power, Biogas plant (library assets), Depot: PV, EV charging and heat pump, PV + battery site (library assets) and 2 more.

## FRACTION

`FRACTION("name", "component")`: 2 arguments.

the share of blended level (or conversion) NAME that is COMPONENT.

Example: `FRACTION("Holder", "ch4")` gives 0.5864.

Used in the bundled models Biogas digester, holder and CHP, Biogas plant (library assets).

## LEVEL

`LEVEL("name")`: 1 argument.

the current value of level NAME.

Example: `LEVEL("Tank")` gives 80.

Used in the bundled models Biogas digester, holder and CHP, Biogas plant (library assets), Depot: PV, EV charging and heat pump, Supply line: order-rate management game and 7 more.

## POWER

`POWER("name")`: 1 argument.

kW resource, fleet or charger NAME draws now, from its "power" per state; a flow it feeds takes rate_time_unit hours.

Example: `POWER("Pump")` gives 1.

Used in the bundled models Hub day: electrifying the ground support equipment, Container terminal: electrification.

## TABLE

`TABLE("name", key1[, key2])`: 2 to 3 arguments.

a value from the model's lookup table NAME, by 1 or 2 keys.

Example: `TABLE("curve", 2.5)` gives 25.

Used in the bundled models Hub day: electrifying the ground support equipment, Hub day: turnaround workload (crews, ground equipment, on-time departures), Job shop (routed, per-product sequences), Job shop with MES digital twin and 1 more.

## TABLE_EXTRAPOLATE

`TABLE_EXTRAPOLATE("name", k1[, k2])`: 2 to 3 arguments.

like TABLE, but a linear axis continues past its ends along its last slope instead of clamping.

Example: `TABLE_EXTRAPOLATE("curve", 12)` gives 64.

## TS

`TS("name"[, t])`: 1 to 2 arguments.

time-series input NAME now, or at time t.

Example: `TS("demand", 2.5)` gives 10.

Used in the bundled models Berth: shore power, Biogas digester, holder and CHP, Biogas plant (library assets), Depot: PV, EV charging and heat pump and 6 more.

## VAR

`VAR("name")`: 1 argument.

model variable NAME, for a name a bare name cannot spell.

Example: `VAR("batch_size")` gives 12.

Used in the bundled models Berth: shore power, Biogas plant (library assets), PV + battery site (library assets), Hub day: electrifying the ground support equipment and 1 more.
